## Limit Sets

::: {#fig-orgin}
![](quasi-fuchsian-limit-set-9.svg){fig-alt="schottky orbit" width=90%}
Orbit of four schottky circles under the action of a Schottky group.
:::

::: {#fig-limitset}
![](schottky_ultra_res_mc_large.png){fig-alt="quasi fuchsian limit set" width=90%}
Limit set of a Schottky group. The limit set is the set of accumulation points of the orbit of a point under the group action. It is a fractal set that can be visualized as a subset of the Riemann sphere.

You need to zoom in to see details.
:::
